text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...I have lost yet again.
Even though I must always achieve victory."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I must be someone worthy of the Mejiro name,
and yet...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"How can I break free from this?
What should I..."
choice_data_list: Calm down, take a deep breath.
Calm down, let's take a deep breath.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"How can I break free from this?
What should I..."
choice_data_list: Calm down, take a deep breath.
Calm down, let's take a deep breath.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...I've calmed down a bit.
I seemed to have been too tense.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I must also learn mental control.
Good grief... I have challenges at every turn, don't I?
choice_data_list: It's simply a matter of not losing.
It's just a matter of not losing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...!
Truly, it was as simple as that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I am fine now. Please guide me through
the training needed to win!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Pardon me. Losing my composure like this 
is nothing short of disgraceful.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: "You want to tell me to grit my teeth for now, and let my results speak next time... Is that what you mean?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Rest assured. I will never back down from a challenge.
Next time I shall claim victory and hold high the Mejiro name!
